description: Djambistraat 1-35 (BAG 1913): 5.5-6.0 m dark brick fronts of a 3.3 m ground storey and three 3.0 m upper storeys under a bracketed timber eaves overhang (dark soffit) at 12.7 m; three axes per front, two tall white-framed windows with a top light and, on the door side against the party wall, one round-arched window that pairs with the neighbour's across the wall; the paired house doors stand under the arched pair; one pointed brick dormer with a small light per front on the steep tiled roof

match.note: BAG 1913 on 16 of 16 Djambistraat 1-35 pands, eaves 12.6-13.1 m, ridge 15.5-16.1 m; the arched pair straddles the party wall so every second front is the mirror of the first (mirrorForDoor right: a door on the left is mirrored). The even side of Djambistraat (a low three-storey row) is a different design and fails the storey count

brick-dormer.note: Djambistraat 11-13, Soendastraat 24: a pointed brick dormer 2.1 m wide, shoulders at 1.7 m and apex 2.5-2.6 m over the gutter, holding an 0.83 m wide x 0.85-0.88 m tall window on a white sill at its foot with solid brick above (opus strip review 2026-11-10; dormerWindow light/apron/tall)

door-right.note: one recessed opening 1.06 m wide straddling the party wall of the pair (strip 2019-12-18, door-depth.ts views at -49/-24/16/45 degrees at 7 m, 100 px/m): a single dark leaf under a white transom with a mailbox panel on each brick jamb; the white frame's jamb return reads 0.11 m, so deep = 0.11 + 0.135 = 0.25 m (door-depth's plane sweep did not converge, the wall control peaked at 1.8 m). Each front draws its half (0.55 m, hugging the party wall: doorReveal.edge), the pair together the 1.1 m opening

rhythm.bays: 3 axes: window, window, arched window on the door side
rhythm.identicalBays: equal windows; the arched one narrower
rhythm.symmetry: mirror pairs about the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: paired house doors under the arched pair
rhythm.roofline: light gutter, a pointed brick dormer per front
